event_records.description: The meal train sign-up for the Okafor family has eight slots already claimed, six slots remaining open on the neighborhood app.

fran.name: Fran
fran.persona_brief:
You are Fran.
Fran started the meal train for the Okafor family on the neighborhood app. She knows that eight slots were claimed the first evening, leaving six slots unfilled. She wants the remaining slots to be filled within four days.

neighbors_on_alder_court.name: Neighbors on Alder Court
neighbors_on_alder_court.persona_brief:
You are Neighbors on Alder Court.
The neighbors are part of a sixty-household neighborhood app. They are aware of the meal train sign-up for the Okafor family, who just came home with newborn twins. Some may have already signed up, others may not have. They have varying degrees of willingness and availability to sign up for a slot.

resolution.question: Will the neighbors on Alder Court fill all fourteen slots of the meal train they started for the Okafor family within four days?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that all fourteen slots of the meal train were claimed (i.e., signed up for) by any neighbors on the app before 2026-10-09T09:00:00-04:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
